text:
zoe: Heads up - I'm iterating on the "hello-mini" onboarding guide. Found a few things: the Docker deploy step uses an old image tag, and the Typescript example imports from the old package name. Opening a PR to fix both.

ben: Can you list the exact lines? I can patch while you're out.

zoe: Sure. In the 'deploy with Docker' step the Dockerfile uses `redwood/runner:alpha` which no longer exists. We should point to `ghcr.io/redwood-inference/runner:stable` and add a note about image variants (cpu/gpu). Also the TS snippet does `import { Client } from 'redwood-sdk'` but we've consolidated packages into `@redwood/inference`.

maria: Good catch. Also the quickstart still suggests using `RW_KEY` env var. New standard is `RW_API_KEY`.

ben: I'll update the Dockerfile and the TS snippet in the docs PR.

zoe: Planning to also add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ: "If build fails with missing libcuda, try the cpu image tag or follow the GPU driver notes link".

docs-bot: PR created by zoe -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/428 (quickstart: docker tag + ts import fix)

kevin: For the typescript example, can we show both ESM and CJS minimal examples? A lot of users copy/paste into various environments.

ben: Good idea; I'll add two short blocks. Keep them tiny.

zoe: I'll add a CI link-check job in a follow-up. For this PR I'll: 1) replace Docker tag, 2) fix TS import, 3) update env var name, 4) add the troubleshooting bullet.

ben: Reviewing now.

docs-bot: PR merged by zoe (CI: green) -> main. Deploying staging docs.

maria: Thanks all. Noting this in the onboarding refresh tracker.

kevin: Nice fast loop.

zoe: one more thing - raising a separate PR to migrate the 'first deployment' section to point at the new Dedicated guide instead of a bare k8s tutorial.

ben: Sounds good, ping when ready.

zoe: Will do.
